45960bae776bc8990d01e7d6c5f941cb3c62f497.summary: A CISA alert, published 2020-12-14 and last revised December 14, 2020, says CISA is aware of active exploitation of SolarWinds Orion Platform software versions 2019.4 HF 5 through 2020.2.1 HF 1, released between March and June 2020. It points readers to SolarWinds and FireEye advisories for details. The referenced FireEye advisory describes a highly evasive attacker that used the SolarWinds supply chain to compromise multiple victims with the SUNBURST backdoor. The alert names no threat actors, CVEs, sectors or countries.

45b3a2b13d89774c21f20c58ae99fdbc196af64a.summary: Affiliates of the ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware group use malvertising: paid ads for business software such as Slack and Cisco AnyConnect lure victims into installing Nitrogen initial-access malware, which precedes ransomware deployment. eSentire's Threat Response Unit says it stopped one such attack. The report also covers the group's healthcare targeting, its recruitment of Octo Tempest, and Microsoft's findings on Magniber malvertising by a Russian group it tracks as Storm-0381.

4599c81f27e04f2ffef748c2cd6c2b8a60f2f906.summary: BleepingComputer reports that the BlackCat (ALPHV) ransomware gang claims to have stolen about 80 GB of data from Reddit in a February cyberattack that Reddit disclosed. Reddit said a phishing attack on one employee gave access to internal docs, source code and some business systems, but not primary production systems or user passwords. The gang says it asked for $4.5 million, got no reply, and now threatens to leak the data. The same group is believed to be linked to a March 2023 attack on Western Digital. The report notes the gang did not encrypt devices.
